Hinduism

Shaktism

Summary
: This is the English translation of the Saubhagyahrdayastotra (“praise to the heart of auspiciousness”) by Sivananda (fl. 13th century South India), who was one of the earliest interpreters of the Tantric tradition of goddess worship known as Shri-Vidya. The Saubhagyahrdaya Stotra embodies Shivananda’s synthesis of foundational Shaiva doctrine, Kundalini practices, and devotional worship, underscoring the Goddess’s omnipotence and allure. 
Alternative transliteration: Śivānanda Saubhāgyahṛdayastotra (शिवानन्द सौभाग्यहृदयस्तोत्र) Shivananda Saubhagyahridayastotra, Śiva-ānanda Saubhāgyahṛdaya-stotra (शिव-आनन्द सौभाग्यहृदय-स्तोत्र), Shiva-ananda Saubhagyahrdaya or Saubhagyahridaya-stotra, Saubhāgya-hṛdaya-stotra (्सौभाग्य-हृदय-स्तोत्र), Saubhagya-hridaya-stotra [hrdaya-stotra].
